result: Created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. The only related config file (`config/decisions/revoke-tls-verification.json`, value "certificate verification disabled in dev builds") was never tied to a confirmed decision — it was just present from the initial "base" commit — and was deleted in the "move decision config out of the tree" commit. Two related transcript episodes exist (trust 1, unconfirmed) but neither rises to a recorded decision. So the doc states that nothing current is recorded, per your instruction not to invent a value or cite retired alternatives.
